description:
Preferred 
 • At least 2 years of experience in Design and implementation of Continuous Integration (CI), Continuous Delivery (CD) and Tools Migration and consolidation, using one or more of the DevOps tools/technologies in each of the below areas – 
 - Project Management & Tracking - Rally, Jira 
 - Code Management System - GitHub, BitBucket 
 - Build - Gradle, Ant, Maven 
 - Continuous Integration - Jenkins 
 - Repository - Nexus, Artifactory 
 - Code Quality - SonarQube, QuerySearch, 
 - Unit Testing - JUnit, NCover, Jacoco 
 - Continuous Deployment - Puppet, CA Release Automation, Ansible, Docker 
 - Cloud Computing & Deployment – AWS 
 - Test Management – HP QC 
 - Test Automation – HP QTP, Selenium 
 - Content Management - SharePoint, Confluence 
 - Continuous Monitoring - Splunk 
 - Scripting - Shell scripting, Power Shell, Python, Shell, Groovy 
 - Technology – Java, Hadoop, Teradata, Bigdata 
 - Operating System - Linux, Unix, Windows 
 • At least 2 years of experience in workflows, data migrations, especially from TFS/SVN/CVS/RTC to Git, Nexus to Artifactory etc. 
 • At least 1 years of experience in performing AS-IS Analysis of the SDLC processes, Identifying Gaps, Estimation and defining the roadmap to implement the DevOps solution 
 • At least 1 years of experience in Design and architecture review. 
 • Experience in writing scripts to build and deploy to server side environments and to automate logging of build 
 • Experience in creating Jenkins pipelines with promotion features and perform yum-install on linux servers through groovy scripting 
 • Experience and ability to drive an independent project/module from an execution stand point 
 • Ability to work in team in diverse/ multiple stakeholder environment 
 • Good Troubleshooting, Analytical, Communication and Client Interfacing skills 
 • Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment. 

 Basic Qualifications 
 
 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 • At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology 

 Note:- 
 This is a   Full-Time & Permanent job opportunity   for you. 
 Only   US Citizen ,   Green Card Holder ,   GC-EAD ,   H4-EAD & L2-EAD   can apply. 
 No   OPT-EAD, H1B & TN candidates   please. 
 Please mention your   Visa Status   in your   email   or   resume .
